montessori.margin_source: PROVISIONAL. Active montessori line (Plan Toys inactive, excluded). Count-weighted blend of brands with cost data: Guidecraft 70 SKUs @ 49.6% (minimal shipping), Tag Toys 55 @ 16.8% (UPS/FedEx commercial on billable weight dim-139 + $5 dropship), Whitney Brothers 21 @ 35.6% (2026 dealer cost vs store price; Ground freight estimated, Truck LTL calibrated from a real Estes quote). Maple Landmark (27) still pending. Break-even ROAS ~3.1.
montessori.label: Montessori toys

carpets.margin_source: Carpets for Kids 2027 dealer cost vs YOUR Magento store prices (brand-verified, 692 SKUs), NET of real freight (free shipping, zone-avg, +$60 XL surcharge). Median net 36.4% all rugs, 38.6% excluding X-Large. Break-even ROAS ~3.0. Caveat: X-Large (8ft x 12ft) rugs are thin/negative and being repriced; advertise non-XL. Regenerate with scripts/ingest_pricesheet.py --sell store.
carpets.label: Classroom rugs

brand_margins._note: Reference margins by brand (NET), from each vendor's wholesale vs your Magento store prices. Line margins are the count-weighted blend of the active brands they contain. Plan Toys are INACTIVE (362 in catalog, 0 online) so they are excluded from line margins.

carpets for kids.note: 692 SKUs, net of real freight; see carpets line.

guide craft.note: 70 matched SKUs, gross median 49.6%, shipping assumed minimal; mix of toys + furniture.

tag toys.note: 62 matched SKUs, net of UPS/FedEx-commercial shipping on billable weight (dim 139) plus $5 dropship fee. Matches the ~15% figure Frank cited.

whitney brothers.note: 121 active SKUs vs 2026 dealer price list, all current. Net median 34.7%: 107 Ground items (~36%, est. UPS/FedEx commercial freight, none negative); 14 Truck items with LTL calibrated from a real Estes quote (WB6400N, 199 lb, $543.63 incl liftgate) = max($350, $2.73/lb), truck median 26.5%, none negative, lowest CH1330N 10.3%. WB ships and bills actual freight.

sku_margins._note: Per-SKU NET margins from vendor invoices, (store price - cost - shipping) / store price, before card fee. Used where no pricesheet exists.
